entries.test: Whether productivity statistics or credible studies up to October 2026 show generative AI producing anything like 10x worker productivity or radical national GDP gains at scale.
entries.note: The bar is very high (10x, radical GDP boosts), so the claim is easy to verify as stated.

entries.test: Whether published studies and company disclosures as of October 2026 document only small measurable financial returns from AI spending compared with the trillions invested.
entries.note: The proposition rightly drops 'perverse and often baffling', which is a value judgment. 'Minimal' is vague but has a plain reading.

entries.test: Whether court records or credible reporting show Character.AI filed for bankruptcy on or before 14 October 2026.
entries.note: This is a plain factual claim.

entries.test: Whether bond market data show CoreWeave bond yields reached about 15% around 13–14 October 2026.
entries.note: The proposition adds 'of AI infrastructure lending', which he did not say, and presents his hedged 'suggesting' inference as fact. Only the yield figure is clearly testable.
